part.text:
I think this is a raytracer, so I want to convert the image so I can view it. The Read tool may not handle PPM, and PIL isn't available, so I'll write a small Python script that builds an uncompressed PNG using zlib's stored blocks. Before running the original program, I should back up image.ppm, since it would overwrite the existing file.

I'm thinking about dropping the PNG-writing approach and instead decompiling the original program and reimplementing it, so I can then look at the image and the disassembly.

input.command: cd /app; objdump -d --no-show-raw-insn orig | awk '/<main>:/,0' | head -20; objdump -t orig | grep -i " F .text"
